context.transcript:
Hi there. Can I help you find anything today?
I begin a new job next week, and I want to get some
clothes. I was just looking at this shirt — | really like
the material. It's such good quality.
Yes. These shirts are very popular. Actually, this
weekend we're running a promotion on men's shirts.
The more you buy, the greater the discount.
Hmm. This is a good discount. I originally only wanted
one shirt, but now I'll get three.
context.transcript_translation:
你好，今天需要我帮你找什么吗？
我下周开始一份新工作，想买些衣服。我刚刚在看这件衬衫——我很喜欢它的面料，质量真好。
是的，这些衬衫很受欢迎。事实上，本周末我们的男士衬衫正在做促销：买得越多，折扣越大。
嗯，这个折扣不错。我原来只想买一件，不过现在我要买三件。
context.content_translation: 本段听力围绕“服装购物”展开。请先听清人物关系和对话目的，再抓取时间、地点、原因、行动等关键信息。
